dedupe_keys.name: epa superfund data and reports sems active and archived site inventories npl sites contaminants and remedies

description: EPA's Superfund Data and Reports page publishes data sets drawn from the Superfund Enterprise Management System (SEMS) on the assessment and remediation of contaminated sites. Contents: all proposed, final and deleted National Priorities List (NPL) sites; the active site inventory (sites where assessment, removal, remedial, enforcement, cost recovery or oversight work is planned or under way) and the archived site inventory, with site and location information and latitude and longitude for NPL sites; completed Records of Decision, amendments and explanations of differences; contaminant of concern and remedy component data by medium from decision documents for fiscal years 1981 onward; lien on property records; and a list of sites with potential smelting-related operations. Producer: EPA Superfund programme. Coverage: United States. Format and access: downloadable reports listed in a searchable table on the page, with site location information and archived data sections and a metadata entry in the EPA Environmental Dataset Gateway. Licence: not stated on the EPA page. Caveats: non-NPL sites carry only a brief status, not coordinates in the active inventory, and the reports are extracts that change as SEMS is updated. Simulation uses: locating contaminated sites that floods, storm surge or wildfire could mobilise near water supplies, ports and transport corridors, and hazard layers for compound risk studies. Related records: data-epa-facility-registry-service and case_study-gao-hazardous-waste-tsdf-climate-risk.
